component.name: Apache Geode
component.description: In-memory data management platform. Every component is built with security considerations as a top priority, but certain security solutions require user-specific design and implementation: the default configuration combines maximum flexibility and performance without any input needed from the user, so authentication, authorization, serialization controls, and over-the-wire encryption are absent from a default installation.

externalReferences.comment: Source security model document; this file is a structured translation of it.

threats.name: Attacks on a default installation without security measures enabled
threats.description: Authentication, authorization, serialization controls, and over-the-wire encryption are absent from a default Geode installation, a deliberate trade-off for flexibility and performance. Reviewing Geode's security capabilities and implementing them is the user's responsibility; certain security solutions require user-specific design and implementation.

controls.name: Review and implement Geode security capabilities
controls.description: It is highly recommended that users review Geode's security capabilities and implement them as they see fit: authentication, authorization, serialization security, and SSL/TLS over-the-wire encryption, starting from the Security Implementation Introduction and Overview. Additional documentation is available on the Apache Geode Wiki (Geode Security Framework and Geode Integrated Security).
